name: Gassantoda Castle
description: Gassantoda Castle was the mountain stronghold of the Amago clan, the Sengoku rulers of Izumo, later taken by the Mori. The extensive kuruwa terraces are a national historic site with a panoramic view of the Nakaumi lagoon.
notes: Free open-air site; a car road reaches the upper bailey. The Yasugi city museum provides context.

ja.name: 月山富田城
ja.description: 尼子氏が三代にわたって拠った月山富田城。中国地方最大級の山城で、中海を見下ろす大規模な郭群が国史跡です。
highlights: 中国地方最大級の山城
ja.notes: 無料の野外遺構。車で上部の郭まで行けます。
